mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reviews (id, user_id, song_id, content, rating) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{songId}, #{content}, #{rating})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, r.song_id, r.content, r.rating, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reviews r JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.song_id = #{songId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
